collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page, the pricing-limits resource page and the public pricing page (English) around 10:39 Beijing time / 02:39Z on 2026-11-17: https://commandcode.ai/docs/plans/goat, https://commandcode.ai/docs/resources/pricing-limits and https://commandcode.ai/pricing, read as published. The RSC payload (modelScope / planScope on the plan page, models + rows on the pricing-limits page), the rendered plan-page model tables (prices, monthly credits, caps) and the official 'Estimated requests' table were read field by field, and the same three pages captured on 2026-11-16 were compared line by line (both the rendered text and the embedded RSC payload diff on budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps / shape / timeOfDay per model). Two new paid models observed (Qwen 4 Max and Tencent Hy4 Flash), no free variant of either observed, plus the same-day observations on the new free model Flint, on the /pricing page wording and on the shared pool wording recorded for context. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. Two new paid models observed on 2026-11-17: 'Qwen 4 Max' (slug qwen4-max, plan-page id 'Qwen/Qwen4-Max', pricing-limits id 'qwen-4-max') and 'Tencent Hy4 Flash' (slug hy4-flash, plan-page id and pricing-limits id both 'tencent/hy4-flash'). Qwen 4 Max: vendor Alibaba, category opensource, blurb 'flagship coding, agentic & knowledge work', launchedAt 2026-11-15, minPlanName Go, 1M context (1000000 tokens), reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored'. Tencent Hy4 Flash: vendor Tencent, category opensource, blurb 'low-cost Hy4 for coding, reasoning & agentic work', launchedAt 2026-11-16, minPlanName Go, 1M context (1024000 tokens), reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored'. Qwen 4 Max is priced $1.50 input / $4.50 output / $0.075 cached read / $1.875 cache write per 1M tokens, Tencent Hy4 Flash is priced $0.07 input / $0.281 output / $0.003 cached read per 1M tokens with no cache-write price listed. Both models carry $15 per-model monthly credits on the GOAT plan (RSC budgetUsd 15, no budgetSteps, credits column '$15'). The RSC payload additionally carries blendedCostPerMTok 2.25 / agentLoopInputPerMTok 0.5025000000000001 for Qwen 4 Max and blendedCostPerMTok 0.12275000000000001 / agentLoopInputPerMTok 0.023100000000000006 for Tencent Hy4 Flash, transcribed as published. The GOAT plan page model counters moved All plans 100 -> 103, GOAT plan 72 -> 75, Deals 3 -> 4, Free 2 -> 3, and the pricing-limits All / Models counter moved 102 -> 105 (Deals 3 -> 4, Free 2 -> 3). The other previously listed paid GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps (GLM-5.3 stays at budgetUsd 70), and the shared-pool wording did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no shared-pool change, no other GOAT row changes, no adopted.csv row.

otherObservations.topic: GOAT plan page wording for the two new models
otherObservations.observation: The plan page body reads: 'New models start at 2x credits i.e. $20 credits on the $10/mo GOAT plan until we negotiate better deals. That's still 2x your money at public API prices, and the allowance updates automatically the moment a deal starts - no codes, no toggles. Qwen 4 Max and Tencent Hy4 Flash start at $15.' The page publishes no end date for that sentence. The 'Deals' counter moved 3 -> 4 on both the plan page and the pricing-limits page, but the two new models carry no deal entry of their own ('$undefined'); the fourth deal is the new 'flint-free' entry. The model objects' deal fields stay '$undefined'.

computationNote: No monthlyYi, no blended per-MTok price and no adopted allowance are computed in this file; all numbers are transcribed as published on the official pages and in the official RSC payload.
confidenceNote: The prices, the per-model credits and the request estimates are official and consistent across the plan page, the pricing-limits page and the RSC payload. Confidence is not 'high' because the plan-page sentence 'Qwen 4 Max and Tencent Hy4 Flash start at $15.' carries no end date and no term, so whether the $15 per-model credit level is permanent or of unstated duration cannot be settled from the captured pages.
